messages:
aisha_cs: Heads-up — Aurelia Labs onboarding showing a problematic tail on the chat endpoint. 95th/p99 spikes to ~1.8s on client traces even though 95% of requests are <300ms. Looks like cold KV cache + lots of single-token batches. Thinking a proactive quant+routing pilot to flatten the tail. @devon_se any quick checks we should run?

devon_se: Can you paste sample logs + current model/config? Also which deployment (hosted/dedicated)?

Aisha_cs: Hosted (standard). Model: redwood/open-chat-v1, batching=1, no prefix cache configured yet. Example log snippet: ```WARN kv_cache_miss seq=1423 warmup_time=220ms``` — spikes correlate with new sessions.

marco_perf: Quick proposal: compact int8 (Q4) variant + hybrid routing. Canary 10% traffic -> quantized variant with aggressive prefix warmup. Short inputs go to quant, long/critical calls fallback to fp16. Expect ~30-40% token cost reduction and big p99 improvement.

nora_sre: We need a small eval to measure quality delta. Ask CS to run 50 representative prompts vs customer golden set and check acceptability. Also define rollback triggers.

aisha_cs: On it — I'll run a 50-sample eval and scrape support examples. Also customer asked about audit logs — will call out Dedicated/VPC as an option if they want full audit trail later.

devon_se: I'll draft a one-pager with: summary, expected savings, risk matrix, opt-in flow. linking internal guide: https://redwood.internal/docs/cs/quant-routing (private). :thumbsup:

perfbot: deploy-bot: Canary created: aurelia-quant-q4 -> 10% traffic, monitoring enabled. Canary window: 12h.

marco_perf: Routing rule idea: if tokens < 128 -> route to open-chat-v1-int8 (Q4) with warmed prefix cache; else -> open-chat-v1 fp16. That limits QA risk on long generative sessions.

nora_sre: Rollback policy draft: trigger rollback to 100% fp16 if p99 latency > 800ms OR error_rate > 0.5% for 10m window. Also add alert for quality regressions if customer acceptability < 90% on sampled responses.

aisha_cs: Action items: a) Aisha runs eval + shares results b) Devon drafts customer-facing email + opt-in c) Marco prepares canary config snippet d) SRE (Nora) wires alerts. Target: propose pilot in customer call Monday.

devon_se: I'll have the draft by EOD today.

aisha_cs: Eval results: 50 prompts run -> 48/50 qualitative accept. similarity metric ~0.98. Two mismatches were short formatting differences. Sharing examples privately.

marco_perf: Canary config snippet (sharing here for feedback):
```
route_rules:
  - condition: tokens < 128
    model: open-chat-v1-int8
    qprofile: Q4
    weight: 0.1
  - condition: default
    model: open-chat-v1-fp16
```

nora_sre: Looks good. I'll add the alert thresholds in Console and set an automated rollback hook. Also will document audit steps if they want Dedicated later.

aisha_cs: Great — scheduling customer call for tomorrow 11am PT to present the pilot. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
